shortDefinition: AI systems that generate images from text descriptions.
fullDefinition: Text-to-image models take a text description (prompt) as input and generate a corresponding image. They use a different architecture from LLMs — typically diffusion models. Major text-to-image tools include DALL-E (OpenAI), Midjourney, Stable Diffusion (open), Adobe Firefly, and Imagen (Google). Quality varies dramatically between tools for different types of images.
examples: DALL-E 3: "a photorealistic image of a red fox in autumn forest"
Midjourney: known for artistic, aesthetic high-quality images
